It is Round 2 of the Women's Rugby League World Cup in Perth, and our model converts that official rating gap into 71.43% for Australia, a fair price of exactly -250 at the edge of the brief's window. The high-confidence call is AUSTRALIA WOMEN TO WIN (match winner).
